question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is '**Postumous**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, the incorrectly spelt word is '**Postumous**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**Posthumous**'.
 
• It refers to something that happens after a person's death or a child born after the death of their father. (Hindi meaning: जन्मान्तरित)
 
 
• *Example: The artist's **posthumous** fame skyrocketed after his death.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Threshold** (correct spelling) - Refers to the level or point at which something begins or changes. It can also mean the entrance to a house or building. (Hindi meaning: अंतर्धान).
 
• **Pedestrian** (correct spelling) - Refers to a person who is walking along a road or street, or something that is dull or lacking in imagination. (Hindi meaning: पैदल यात्री)
 
• **Garrison** (correct spelling) - Refers to a military post or station, or the troops stationed there. It can also mean assigning troops to a military post or station. (Hindi meaning: सेनागृह)
